package.name: j10_vla
package.description: Vision-language-action inference. Loads a backend, feeds it the latest camera frame, the active instruction and vehicle state, and publishes NavIntent at 5-10 Hz with measured inference latency. Inference runs off the executor thread and the frame buffer holds exactly one frame, so a slow model delays only itself and never queues stale input. Ships the Phase 4 scripted backend; a real checkpoint plugs into the same Backend interface in Phase 5.
